title: Jump Game
statement: Each nums[i] is the maximum number of steps you may jump forward from index i. Starting at index 0, return whether you can reach the last index.
constraints: 1 <= nums.Length <= 10^4 on the examples, 200000 on the stress case
hints: The quadratic DP that asks is index j reachable for every pair will not survive the stress case.
Sweep once, holding the furthest index reachable so far.
If you ever stand on an index beyond that reach, you are stuck and the answer is false. Otherwise extend the reach to max(reach, i + nums[i]).
